messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency SLO breach detected on /streaming/generate (hosted-us-west). current p99=2.7s > SLO 1.5s. rate of errors increased. paging-related metric: prefix_cache_hit_rate dropped from 92% -> 34% in 5m :warning:

sre_kim: ack. I’m on it — grabbing traces and cache metrics. Paging + prefix cache sounds like the usual suspect.

eng_jess: adding context: we rolled prefixhash v2 to 30% 12:05 UTC, config change touched prefix hashing/namespace mapping. Could be rollout related.

eng_dave: seeing streaming stalls in the logs around 12:18-12:24. lots of long tail traces with repeated KV lookups that omitted cached prefix keys. example trace id: trc-9f3b2a.

sre_kim: query results:
```
SELECT percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p95, percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p99
FROM request_latency
WHERE route = '/streaming/generate' AND ts > now() - interval '15 minutes';
-- p95=980, p99=2700
```

eng_jess: prefetech/cache metrics: prefix_cache_hit_rate by shard: shard-a=30%, shard-b=36%, shard-c=31%. Pre-rollout baseline ~90%. Prefetch queue length spiked -> paging fallback.

product_arjun: any customer-facing errors? Any increases in 5xx or timeouts?

eng_dave: 5xxs up from 0.02% -> 0.7%. Most are 504 from streaming gateway due to long tail stalls. No large customer-facing persistence errors yet, but degraded tail latency for streaming sessions (chat UIs will spin/timeout at 10s). Notified support.

ops-bot: Pager assigned to @sre_kim. Runbook: prefix-cache-miss -> attempt rollout rollback or warm cache.

sre_kim: mitigation proposal: 1) Abort/rollback prefixhash v2 rollout to 0% 2) Trigger cache warmers for hot prefixes 3) Temporarily increase retry window on streaming gateway to avoid 504s 4) Route high-QPS traffic to dedicated pool in us-east while we stabilize.

eng_jess: rolling back rollout now. patch: 
```
kubectl -n infra apply -f prefixhash-rollout-revert.yaml
# rollout percentage -> 0
```

eng_jess: rollback started at 12:26 UTC. will monitor hit rates.

eng_dave: started a manual cache warmup for top 500 prefixes via job warmup/v1. Logs show kv fetch success and fill events.

sre_kim: monitoring dashboards: prefix_cache_hit_rate now creeping up from 34% -> 58% in 6m after revert + warmers. p99 dropping: 2.7s -> 1.4s currently. p95 stable ~900ms.

product_arjun: quick customer impact summary for support & comms: "Some hosted streaming sessions experienced tail latency spikes and intermittent timeouts starting 12:15 UTC due to a prefix-hash rollout. Majority of customers unaffected but sessions using streaming saw degraded responsiveness for ~20-30 minutes. Mitigation in progress; rollback executed."

eng_jess: note: the rollout exposed an edge-case where namespace mapping changed ordering leading to cache key mismatches for legacy prefixes. Fix will be in next minor before re-roll. Creating PR with deterministic mapping and migration plan.

eng_dave: collecting sample keys that missed: keys list: pref_3a4b, pref_8c9d, pref_hot_42. Will attach to the PR for unit tests.

sre_kim: post-mitigation checks: 1) sustain >85% prefix_cache_hit_rate for 15m 2) p99 < 1.5s for 10m 3) no customer 5xx spike for 30m. If stable, we’ll close incident.

ops-bot: Incident severity set to Sev3 -> actionable SLO breach with partial customer impact.

matt: on-call takeover in 20m. @sre_kim please drop a handoff with current state, actions taken, and watch triggers.

sre_kim: handoff note:
- timeline: issue start ~2259000000 (12:15 UTC) following prefixhash v2 canary to 30%
- impact: p99 spike to 2.7s, p95 ~980ms, prefix cache hit rate fell to ~34% -> caused streaming stalls/504s for a minority of sessions. 5xx rose to 0.7% briefly.
- mitigations applied: rollback to 0% at 12:26 UTC, cache warmers started, stream gateway retry window extended, some routing diversion to dedicated pool.
- current state: prefix cache hit rate 58% and climbing, p99 ~1.4s and dropping, 5xx back to ~0.08%. No new customer escalations.
- follow-ups: eng_jess to open PR for deterministic namespace mapping + migration tests; eng_dave to add a cache-warming job to rollout playbook; sre_kim to run incident blameless postmortem and coordinate with product for comms if needed.

matt: thanks — I’ve picked this up. monitoring until end of shift, will escalate to eng if regressions reappear. If metrics cross triggers (p99>1.6s or hit_rate<70% for 10m), wake me and paging team.

eng_jess: created PR: https://git.internal/redwood/prefixhash-fix/pull/487 — includes tests and rollback safety flag.

eng_dave: uploaded warmup logs to S3: s3://redwood-logs/incidents/2259000000/warmup.log

sre_kim: closing note for now: keeping the thread open until metrics stable 30m. leaving detailed runbook edits in docs (link below).

product_arjun: thanks team. I’ll sync with support to prep a short kb note in case customers ask.

incident-bot: UPDATE: metrics have met closure criteria for 30 minutes. p99=1.2s, p95=820ms, prefix_cache_hit_rate=88%. Incident resolved -> moving to postmortem.

sre_kim: creating postmortem stub now, will include timeline, decisions, RCA, and action items. handing off to eng for follow-through on code fix.

matt: handing off final watch to night team @matt. If anything pops, ping on-call and this thread. Good job everyone :thumbsup:
